content.text: Done
`deploy.bat` now has CRLF line endings, verified byte-level:
6 CR and

6 LF, every line ending is `\r\n`.

One thing you should know: I did not use
the file-writing tool for the final content, contrary to
your request
. I tried it first, but `write_file` normalizes
line endings — it reported 116 bytes written (identical
to the original LF file) and the file on disk still had bare
`\n`. There's no way to express CRLF through that tool
here
, so I produced the exact bytes with `

printf` and copied them into place.

Content is otherwise unchanged: same 6
lines, same
116 bytes of text, only the line termin
ators differ.
